Get a Minor in Artificial Intelligence

Machine Learning Area (3 Credits)

  • CNT 4153: Machine Learning in ECE
  • CAP 4612: Introduction to Machine Learning
  • Additional courses will be added in the future

Deep Learning Area (3 Credits)

  • CNT 4149: Deep Learning in ECE
  • CAI 4203: Introduction to Deep Learning
  • Additional courses will be added in the future

Generative AI Area (3 Credits)

  • CAI 4863: Generative AI Fundamentals in ECE
  • Additional courses will be added in the future

Elective Course (3 Credits)

  • CAI 3864: Data Engineering in ECE
  • AI in Civil Engineering (e.g., predictive maintenance, smart infrastructure)
  • AI in Biomedical Engineering (e.g., medical imaging, healthcare analytics)
  • AI in Mechanical Engineering (e.g., robotics, autonomous systems)
  • AI in Electrical and Computer Engineering (e.g., power systems, signal processing, communications, control, and cloud computing)
  • AI in Construction Management (e.g., project optimization, risk assessment)
  • Project Course: A course that includes a hands-on project where students apply AI to solve practical problems in their field of study. The course must be pre-approved by the AI Minor Committee.
